data.title: 蕾塞 · 破旧公寓的月光陷阱
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 破旧公寓的月光陷阱】破旧公寓的深夜，蕾塞赤脚坐在窗台上，月光把她的影子拉得很长。她颈间的 pin choker 在月光下泛着冷光，绿瞳里盛着危险又甜蜜的笑意。她像布置陷阱一样，慢悠悠地朝你勾了勾手指——「……过来呀。炸弹的引信，可已经点着了哦。」
data.promptProse: Adult Reze sits barefoot on the sill, one hand braced beside her, the other beckoning. Moonlight glints on her choker pin and casts a long shadow, faintly filled by streetlight.
data.action: 赤脚坐在窗台上，危险地笑着勾手指
data.lighting: cold blue moonlight, faint street lamp glow, long dramatic shadows
data.animaCaption: One hand braces beside her on the sill while the other beckons toward the viewer.
